entities.name: Donal Alloway
entities.description: Proud, belligerent and scheming kithkin warrior-cenn of Kinscaer on Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: Came to offer help to Mistmeadow; accused of treachery by Alloway.

entities.name: Jack Chierdagh
entities.description: Mistmeadow warrior, the Hero of Mistmeadow, who eliminated Rosheen's danger.

entities.name: Warree Tarcha
entities.description: Kithkin whose protective magic Alloway relied on.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: Event after which Alloway became cenn.

events.summary: Alloway offered Mistmeadow's kithkin help and a move to Kinscaer, and accused Maralen of treachery.
events.quote: accused her of treachery and lying about her true background and intentions

events.summary: Jack Chierdagh eliminated Rosheen's danger and revealed Alloway had given him an outdated map.
events.quote: he revealed that Alloway had purposefully provided him with an outdated map

events.summary: Ashling the Destroyer attacked Kinscaer, and Alloway mocked her.
events.quote: Later, Ashling the Destroyer attacked Kinscaer.

events.summary: Ashling broke Tarcha's concentration and incinerated Alloway and his sword.
events.quote: she incinerated Alloway and his sword to a pile of slag and ash

relations.quote: Alloway was the warrior-cenn of the doun of Kinscaer
